channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight widespread remote code execution and authentication bypass risks across web security, cloud infrastructure, and network devices, with critical flaws impacting products like Windows Paint, Juniper networks gear, and OpenSSH. Significant threats also target industrial control systems and database middleware through injection attacks and deserialization exploits, while emerging AI workflows face prompt injection and sandbox escape vulnerabilities. Notable vendor disclosures include Emerson, GitHub Enterprise, and pgAdmin, underscoring severe compromises in enterprise management consoles and developer tools.

item.title: CVE-2026-83844 — Desktop OS
item.description: Windows Paint contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code over the network. Its widespread presence and remote exploitability make it a high-priority target.

item.title: CVE-2026-86044 — Desktop OS
item.description: JupyterLab Desktop exposes internal server information to web renderers without validating the page origin. This flaw enables malicious local web pages to intercept sensitive session data.

item.title: CVE-2026-95722 — Desktop OS
item.description: The HPE Virtual Intranet Access client suffers from a local privilege escalation flaw. Low-privileged attackers can leverage this to execute arbitrary commands with elevated system rights.

item.title: CVE-2026-114549 — Desktop OS
item.description: NoMachine's heap-based buffer overflow allows unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising remote desktop sessions immediately upon connection.

item.title: CVE-2026-93520 — Desktop OS

item.title: CVE-2026-119332 — Desktop OS
item.description: The Ladybird browser's JavaScript engine incorrectly handles finalization records, allowing attacker-controlled heap corruption and arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-109836 — Desktop OS

item.title: CVE-2026-123832 — Desktop OS

item.title: CVE-2026-123831 — Desktop OS

item.title: CVE-2026-101598 — Desktop OS

item.title: CVE-2026-108094 — Desktop OS
